tasks.label: Setup: install dependencies
tasks.detail: Creates .venv, installs Python + npm packages, and copies .env.example to .env if missing
tasks.command: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt pytest && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && cd frontend && npm install

windows.command: python -m venv .venv; .venv\Scripts\pip install -r backend/requirements.txt pytest; if (!(Test-Path .env)) { Copy-Item .env.example .env }; cd frontend; npm install

tasks.label: Check setup
tasks.detail: Fails fast with a helpful message if setup hasn't been run
tasks.command: test -d .venv && test -d frontend/node_modules || { echo 'Run the task "Setup: install dependencies" first (Terminal > Run Task).'; exit 1; }; test -f .env || echo 'Warning: no .env file - copy .env.example to .env and add your API keys.'

windows.command: if (!(Test-Path .venv) -or !(Test-Path frontend/node_modules)) { Write-Host 'Run the task "Setup: install dependencies" first (Terminal > Run Task).'; exit 1 }; if (!(Test-Path .env)) { Write-Host 'Warning: no .env file - copy .env.example to .env and add your API keys.' }
